note: Public roadmap: shipped milestones from the changelog and release history, planned items from the design record. Compiled 2026-09-10.

items.title: CI/CD and centralized logs
items.text: Every change is tested and deployed by CI, and all service logs land in one searchable log store.

items.title: Pluggable dataset backends
items.text: Pull training data from Zenodo, S3-compatible object storage or a data-plane service through one interface.

items.title: Model scaffolding and registry guard
items.text: Generate a new model skeleton with one command; CI rejects a broken model registry.

items.title: Multi-stage model lifecycle
items.text: Move models through Staging, Canary and Production aliases; serving follows the alias and reloads automatically.

items.title: Control plane and drift detection
items.text: Request a retrain over an API and have prediction drift detected automatically.

items.title: Framework adapters
items.text: Train scikit-learn, PyTorch and Hugging Face models through the same pipeline.

items.title: Dashboard foundations
items.text: Browse models with per-model READMEs, an artifact gallery and authenticated access in a web dashboard.

items.title: HPC message-bus bridge
items.text: Serve predictions to HPC clients over the facility message bus and retrain automatically when model code is merged.

items.title: Dashboard service controls
items.text: Start, stop and restart platform services and tail their logs from the dashboard.

items.title: YAML-driven model registry
items.text: Declare models in YAML with per-environment overlays; each model gets its own training deployment. Includes multi-user JupyterHub notebooks.

items.title: Composable inference pipeline
items.text: Requests flow through ingress, feature transformation and a model router before prediction.

items.title: Sysadmin approval gate
items.text: Model changes from CI wait for an administrator to approve or reject them, from the CLI or the dashboard.

items.title: Model-zoo webhooks and freshness
items.text: GitLab/GitHub webhooks keep the platform in sync with the model repository, with freshness badges.

items.title: Approval-gate metrics
items.text: Approval queue activity is exported as Prometheus metrics.

items.title: Per-model YAML source of truth
items.text: Each model's YAML file is the single place its configuration lives.

items.title: Four-area monorepo
items.text: Platform, pipelines, serving and model code live in clearly separated packages in one workspace.

items.title: Pipeline operations CLI
items.text: Deploy, export and scaffold pipelines from the exa CLI and a dashboard Pipelines page; options show their valid choices in --help.

items.title: Alerting and distributed tracing
items.text: Get Alertmanager alerts and follow requests end to end with OpenTelemetry traces in Grafana Tempo.

items.title: Skipper operations agent
items.text: Ask an AI operations agent to inspect and act on the platform, with confirmation before any write.

items.title: Operational observability store
items.text: Diff model versions, view lineage, drift, audit history and traffic from exa commands backed by one shared platform store.

items.title: Closed-loop auto-retrain
items.text: Turn on automatic retraining when drift crosses a threshold, with a dry-run preview.

items.title: Input embedding drift
items.text: Detect drift in the inputs themselves, not only in predictions, against a stored baseline.

items.title: Pipeline validation gate
items.text: Smoke-test a model's serving latency before promotion; the command fails CI on an SLA breach. Adds exa doctor self-diagnosis.

items.title: Smoke checks and self-healing
items.text: Deployments are smoke-checked after rollout and unhealthy containers are restarted automatically.

items.title: Delivery toolkit
items.text: Roll back models, run shadow and A/B tests, batch inference, explanations, hyperparameter searches, model cards and namespaces from the CLI.

items.title: Platform-wide fault tolerance
items.text: A shared resilience layer (retries, circuit breakers, timeouts) removes single points of failure across services.

items.title: HPC scheduler abstraction
items.text: Submit training to Slurm or Flux (or a mock) through one scheduler-neutral interface over SSH, with GPU/account/QoS resources and job cost linked to runs.

items.title: Feedback, A/B stats, FinOps
items.text: Join ground-truth labels back to predictions, analyze A/B tests with proper statistics, and track budgets and carbon emissions.

shipped.name: Agent-native CLI and the new dashboard

items.title: Agent long-term memory
items.text: The Skipper agent remembers procedures, episodes and preferences across sessions using local embeddings, with export and erase controls.

items.title: Agent-native CLI via MCP
items.text: Expose platform capabilities as MCP tools (exa mcp serve) with an A2A agent card; writes require explicit opt-in.

items.title: Conversational CLI front door
items.text: Ask questions in plain English (exa ask), get explained help (exa explain) and did-you-mean suggestions.

items.title: Live terminal views
items.text: Watch status auto-refresh in the terminal with inline sparklines and bars.

items.title: Output formats and completion
items.text: Print any command as table, JSON, YAML or CSV, and install shell completion.

items.title: Safe mutating commands
items.text: Preview retrains with --dry-run, confirm before changes, and have every trigger audited.

items.title: Config profiles and contexts
items.text: Switch between named environments (exa config use) and see where each setting came from (exa env).

items.title: CLI plugin system
items.text: Install third-party exa subcommands as Python packages.

items.title: MCP resources and prompts
items.text: Agents can read platform context as MCP resources and run guided workflows such as drift diagnosis and safe promotion.

items.title: Generated CLI reference
items.text: Generate the full command reference from the live CLI so docs cannot drift (exa docs).

items.title: Dashboard next-gen (24 features)
items.text: A rebuilt dashboard with MLOps, facility, LLMOps, FinOps, governance and self-observability consoles, command palette, accessibility, i18n (EN/IT), NOC wall and embedded copilot.

items.title: Pluggable calculation providers
items.text: Swap the formula behind carbon and cost calculations via config, inline expressions or plugins, without code changes.

items.title: HPC fleet management
items.text: Discover clusters, approve them before use, place jobs on the best cluster, preflight them and account GPU-hours, cost and carbon.

items.title: Programmable MLOps and autopilot
items.text: Extend the platform through a typed SDK, provider registry and policy-as-code, and run a self-driving autopilot with a kill switch and approval hooks.

items.title: Next-Gen 40 wave 1 (13 features)
items.text: Dataset versioning, lineage, data contracts, prompt registry, secrets, relationship RBAC, model signing/BOM, inference engines, eval suites and gates, model gateway and KServe manifests (A1, A2, A5, B1, B2, C1, C2, C3, D3, D6, D7, E1, E2).

items.title: RAG and guardrails
items.text: Vector store, semantic cache, retrieval-augmented generation with citations and guardrails for injection/PII (B3, B4, B5, D8).

items.title: Quality and governance depth
items.text: AgentOps analytics, concept drift, model-quality SLOs, shadow and champion-challenger, fairness, EU AI Act tooling, NIST AI RMF controls and an immutable audit trail (C4-C8, D1, D2, D4).

items.title: Features, reproducibility, GPU
items.text: Feature store, asset-centric pipelines, reproducibility bundles, Croissant/model cards, GPU sharing, autoscaling policies and fine-tuning adapter registry (A3, A4, A6, A8, B7, E3, E5).

items.title: Next-Gen 40 infra waves
items.text: Policy-as-code engine, distributed and federated training, embedding lifecycle, structured output, KV-aware inference gateway and heterogeneous/hybrid HPC-cloud placement (D5, E6, B6, B8, E4, E7, E8).

items.title: Synthetic data generation
items.text: Generate synthetic datasets with fidelity and privacy checks; synthetic-only models are refused at promotion. Completes 40/40 first implementations.

items.title: Projects and workspaces
items.text: Group models, pipelines, connections, storage, members, budgets and notebooks into one project workspace, from CLI, dashboard or agent.

items.title: Dashboard edit parity
items.text: Create and test connections, manage project members and provision project storage from the dashboard using the same code paths as the CLI.

items.title: Enterprise readiness phase 0
items.text: Safe multi-writer operation: storage backend seam, concurrency-safe audit chain, atomic autopilot triggers, hardened defaults, telemetry retention and backup/restore with DR drill.

items.title: Enterprise foundations, first slices
items.text: Helm chart, event outbox, admission queue, OIDC token validation, key rotation, WORM audit anchor, Prometheus SD, reports, fleet what-if simulation and signed exchange packages.

items.title: Platform vs use-case separation
items.text: Deployment-specific models and configs live in installable use-case packs on top of a use-case-agnostic platform.

items.title: Whole-platform backup and recovery
items.text: Back up and restore every store (databases, object storage, config) as one bundle, on a schedule, off-site.

items.title: Live grid carbon intensity
items.text: Carbon accounting can use a live grid carbon-intensity feed instead of a static factor.

items.title: Grouped CLI help
items.text: exa --help groups commands into 12 MLOps-lifecycle panels.

items.title: Self-documenting CLI groups
items.text: Every command group shows common tasks and where to learn more; every command and dashboard action has a documented use case and example.

items.title: Next-gen Skipper agent
items.text: Supervisor with specialist skills, docs-grounded answers, layered write-safety tiers, self-instrumentation, monitoring memory and per-project memory scoping.

items.title: Enterprise dashboard rebuild
items.text: Lifecycle-organized navigation and new consoles for traffic, events, admission, scaling, providers, SLOs, secrets, feature store, fairness and autopilot.

items.title: Platform ops from notebooks
items.text: Govern the platform from a notebook through a single facade.

items.title: vLLM and vision-language serving
items.text: Serve LLMs and vision-language models through a vLLM server with token streaming, health checks, metrics and HPC or external launchers (exa serve llm).

items.title: Postgres datastore backend
items.text: Run platform state on Postgres instead of SQLite for multi-writer deployments.

items.title: Judge calibration gate
items.text: An LLM judge must be calibrated (agreement, position bias, repeatability) before its scores can gate a promotion.

items.title: Agent quality measurement
items.text: Measure the agent across the whole CLI for correctness, grounding, safety refusals, latency and cost, with history.

items.title: Correctness set
items.text: Silent-data-corruption detection that suppresses drift retrains, typed carbon signals, and a quantization parity gate before promotion.

items.title: Causal evidence chain
items.text: Audit events carry correlation, on-behalf-of and rollback references so an action's full chain can be reconstructed.

items.title: Next-Gen 40 gap closure
items.text: Live traffic mirroring for shadow deployments, enforced data contracts, lineage on training/promotion/retrain, gateway guardrails and schema-valid responses, and EU Declaration of Conformity export.

items.title: CI-built releases with rollback
items.text: Releases are built once in CI, deployed by digest, recorded in the audit chain, and can be rolled back even when the pipeline is red.

items.title: Governed autonomy prerequisites
items.text: Autonomous behaviours publish blast-radius contracts, can be set per behaviour to autonomous/review/disabled, interrupted mid-run, and telemetry is anchored into the audit chain.

items.title: API contract guard
items.text: Control-plane API changes become reviewable diffs; accidental interface changes fail CI.

items.title: CLI Console in dashboard
items.text: Run any exa command from the dashboard through generated forms, with read/admin/destructive tiers and full audit.

planned.name: Close the loop
planned.text: The two steps that finish the governed drift-to-retrain loop.

items.title: Approval on drift-triggered retrains
items.text: Route drift-triggered retrains through the human approval queue; today approval gates CI-driven model changes, while drift retrains are governed by cooldowns, storm caps, corruption checks and audit.

items.title: Live Flux-scheduled retrain
items.text: Exercise one complete drift-to-retrain loop as a real Flux-scheduled job with measured queue wait (the adapter exists; a live closed loop has not been run).

planned.name: Finish what has started
planned.text: Capabilities that ship today with a named piece still missing.

items.title: Hosted lineage server
items.text: Ship an optional lineage-server profile to browse the provenance graph; events are already emitted.

items.title: Standard data-contract engine + CI step
items.text: Adopt a standard validation engine and a blocking CI data-validation step; contracts already gate training.

items.title: Eval gate in CI and dashboard
items.text: A blocking CI job before any alias move and a dashboard page showing the gate report.

items.title: MLflow prompt registry backend
items.text: Store prompts in the MLflow prompt registry in addition to the built-in store.

items.title: External secrets manager
items.text: Run an external secrets manager and inject secrets into every service at startup.

items.title: Dedicated compliance page
items.text: A standalone dashboard Compliance page (compliance currently lives inside the Governance console).

items.title: Online feature store for serving
items.text: An online feature store and serving that reads feature views directly, removing train/serve skew; plus scheduled materialization.

items.title: Hybrid search and ANN indexes
items.text: Hybrid dense+sparse search, configurable ANN indexes, and ingestion from features and drift snapshots.

items.title: More SLO sources
items.text: SLIs from gateway latency/errors, a serving availability probe and live Prometheus evaluation.

items.title: Champion-challenger naming alignment
items.text: Shadow mirroring and challenger scoring have shipped; remaining work aligns the scoreboard naming with the design before formal acceptance.

items.title: Standard fairness engine
items.text: Optionally adopt a standard fairness library instead of the built-in metric implementation.

items.title: Standard guardrail engines
items.text: Integrate established PII and policy guardrail engines alongside the built-in detectors.

items.title: Autoscaling actuation
items.text: Apply scaling decisions automatically (including scale-to-zero with cold-start activation); decisions are computed today but applied by an operator.

items.title: Constrained decoding and reasoning budgets
items.text: Constrain generation to a schema at decode time and enforce and account reasoning-token budgets in the gateway and FinOps.

items.title: Dashboard asset views
items.text: Browse data/model assets and their staleness in the dashboard.

items.title: One-command reproduction
items.text: Rebuild code, data and environment and re-run training automatically from a reproducibility bundle; today the bundle is verified and the rebuild steps are listed.

items.title: Encoder registry in MLflow
items.text: Keep the embedding-encoder registry as MLflow artifacts.

items.title: Real fine-tuning jobs
items.text: Run actual PEFT/LoRA fine-tuning on the scheduler with measured eval scores, and serve multiple adapters through the engine; the adapter registry and promotion gate exist, but fine-tuning itself does not train yet.

items.title: Distributed training from pipeline run
items.text: Launch distributed training directly from the standard pipeline run command.

items.title: Live KServe activation
items.text: Deploy models to KServe on Kubernetes; manifests are generated today.

items.title: Keyless signing and transparency log
items.text: Keyless Sigstore signing with a public transparency log for models and audit checkpoints; key-based signing and a WORM anchor exist.

items.title: Insufficient-evidence reporting
items.text: Compliance packs name their own evidence gaps instead of omitting them.

items.title: Carbon-aware placement benchmark
items.text: Benchmark any multi-objective carbon placement policy against a simple baseline and define a retirement criterion before shipping it built-in.

items.title: LLM serving topology as policy
items.text: Prefill/decode topology and routing as runtime policy, paired TTFT/TPOT SLOs, and engine/accelerator-family parity checks.

items.title: Dry-run everywhere
items.text: Extend dry-run, confirmation and audit to the remaining mutating commands.

items.title: GPU LLM serving
items.text: Originally deferred GPU feature #1; vLLM server mode shipped, GPU quantization and throughput targets pending.

items.title: GPU scheduling and GPU-aware serving
items.text: Originally deferred GPU feature #2; scheduler-neutral GPU resources and fractional-allocation planning exist, live GPU validation pending.

items.title: Elastic autoscaling
items.text: Originally deferred GPU feature #3; scaling policy decisions exist, automatic actuation pending.

items.title: Multi-node distributed training
items.text: Originally deferred GPU feature #4; distributed/fault-tolerant training module exists, live multi-node GPU runs pending.

planned.name: Enterprise scale
planned.text: High availability, identity, fleet observability and one versioned API.

items.title: HA and horizontal scale-out
items.text: Survive a host loss and scale out: HA Postgres/object storage on Kubernetes, live event broker fan-out, Redis coordination, worker fleets, serving autoscaling and model sharding, agent replicas, bulk HPC polling. Shipped: Helm chart with rolling upgrades, event outbox/relay, admission queue, coordination seam, non-blocking HPC wait, SSE resume, capacity aggregation.

items.title: Identity, tenancy and governance
items.text: Single sign-on (OIDC/SAML/SCIM), per-user identity in every audit record, cloud KMS, keyless signing, dedicated authorization service and hard per-tenant isolation. Shipped: OIDC token validation, key rotation, WORM audit anchor, OpenFGA model export, cross-tenant conformance test.

items.title: Fleet observability and reporting
items.text: Node and GPU telemetry across thousands of nodes, long-term HA metrics, scheduled reports and a customer-facing SLA report. Shipped: Prometheus SD from the fleet registry, collector/remote-write config, cardinality guard, alert routing with heartbeat, report generation, SLO burn-rate engine, telemetry retention prune.

items.title: Cohesion, contract and UI scale
items.text: One versioned API across domains, typed settings, fleet-scale tables in the UI, full localization and load/chaos test tiers. Shipped: per-domain data modules, SDK decoupling, surface contract tests, env validation, result envelope, keyset pagination primitive, agent circuit breaker, API contract guard.

items.title: Futuristic differentiation
items.text: Fleet digital twin with spatial view, predictive autopilot, carbon+cost bursting, 3D fleet/NOC wall, governed NL fleet copilot, cross-institution exchange, compliance-as-product. Shipped: what-if simulation, drift forecasting and root-cause classifier, carbon/cost placement providers, heatmap tile API, fleet_simulate agent tool, signed exchange packages, Annex IV/V generation.

planned.name: Agent governance
planned.text: Designed, not built: governed identities and brokers for autonomous agents.

items.title: Governance spine and capability broker
items.text: Agent identities with scoped just-in-time grants, re-authorization on every hop, signed capability descriptors, guardrail boundaries and per-call cost caps.

items.title: Data and compute brokers
items.text: Short-lived credential vending for data, agent memory as a governed dataset, hybrid retrieval, quota-reserving compute admission and a Kubernetes/Kueue adapter.

items.title: Suspend and resume
items.text: One suspend/resume service used by preemption, backfill, carbon shifting and fault recovery.

planned.name: Later
planned.text: Deferred, or planned without a date.

items.title: GPU quantization compute
items.text: Real AWQ/GPTQ/FP8 quantization on GPU hosts; without a GPU it is recorded as provenance-only and the parity gate reports inert.

items.title: MCP OAuth 2.1 transport
items.text: Authenticated remote MCP access for agents on other hosts.

items.title: Pipeline-as-code DSL
items.text: Define pipelines in a typed DSL compiled to an intermediate representation.

items.title: GitOps reconcile and webhooks
items.text: Reconcile platform state from Git and emit outbound event webhooks.

items.title: Full-screen terminal UI
items.text: A Textual-based exa tui live dashboard.

items.title: Per-project JupyterHub spawn
items.text: Launch a JupyterHub notebook server scoped to a project.

items.title: Project label on serving metrics
items.text: Break down serving metrics per project in Prometheus.

items.title: Automatic memory distillation
items.text: Automatically distill procedures and reflect on episodes in the background; review queue in the dashboard.

items.title: Dashboard SSO and tenant switcher
items.text: OIDC sign-in, tenant switcher, service accounts with scoped tokens, and step-up for governed actions.

items.title: Dashboard E2E and visual tests
items.text: End-to-end browser journeys, visual regression, bundle budgets and preview deploys in CI.

items.title: Dashboard self-observability
items.text: Self-hosted JS error tracking, browser tracing, web-vitals and synthetic monitoring.

items.title: Signed release archives
items.text: Sign release archives in CI.

items.title: Explained placement decisions
items.text: Show why a cluster was chosen (exa hpc place --explain).
